chapter_meta_description: The Meng Mountain Friends face a bitter truth: their Fifth Sister has been a Black Fiend Sect spy for two years. Han Li’s intervention is swift, but his decision to let her escape is colder than any blade. Why?
og_title: The Inside Agent is Exposed – A Mortal’s Journey Ch.308
og_description: The Meng Mountain Friends face a bitter truth: their trusted sister has been a spy for two years. Han Li’s mercy is not kindness—it is a calculated gamble.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch.308 – The Cost of Trust
twitter_description: A traitor is exposed. A Heaven Thunder Seed is raised. And Han Li lets her run. This is the Mortal Stream: where mercy is just another move on the board.

lore_anchors.definition: A single-use explosive artifact created by compressing a bolt of heavenly thunder into a portable orb; a classic high-stakes trump card that is consumed forever upon use.
A martial technique that temporarily disables an opponent by striking specific energy points on the body, blocking the flow of qi.

The second major cultivation realm, representing a fundamental restructuring of the body and energy system; a Qi Condensation cultivator is practically helpless against a Foundation Establishment cultivator.
